tool.name: linkedin_jobs_search
tool.title: LinkedIn Public Job Listings Search
tool.description:
Search public LinkedIn job postings by keyword and location without logging in, returning role title, hiring company, location, posting date, and job URL.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/linkedin-public-jobs-search'.
- Side Effects: Reads public sources and creates a billed Actor run and dataset on your Apify account.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typical run duration is 15-40 seconds; timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for hiring-trend research, talent-market mapping, competitor headcount signals, or sourcing public job openings by role and location.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for LinkedIn people/profile search, private candidate data, or submitting job applications.
- Named alternatives: Use 'glassdoor_jobs_search' for Glassdoor's own listings and employer ratings, or 'google_play_reviews_search'/'youtube_video_search' for app-review or video data instead of hiring data.

search_query.description: Job title, skill, or keyword to search in public LinkedIn job listings (e.g. 'data engineer' or 'registered nurse').

location.description: City, region, or country used to localize results (e.g. 'Seattle, WA'). Defaults to all locations if empty.

max_results.description: Maximum number of job listings to retrieve. Defaults to 10.

include_details.description: When true, opens each job posting to add seniority level, employment type, job function, industries, applicant count, and full job description. Costs one extra request per job, so runs take noticeably longer. Defaults to false.

company.title: Company
company.description: Structured company value returned by the upstream source.

location.title: Location
location.description: Structured location value returned by the upstream source.

url.title: Canonical listing URL
url.description: Direct URL for the source listing.

posted_at_timestamp.title: Posting timestamp (ISO 8601)
posted_at_timestamp.description: posted_at parsed into a UTC ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when posted_at is missing or not in a recognized absolute-date or relative-age ('3 days ago', 'Just now') shape.

job_id.title: LinkedIn job ID
job_id.description: Numeric LinkedIn job posting ID, stable across runs and usable as a join key.

company_url.title: Company LinkedIn page
company_url.description: URL of the hiring organisation's LinkedIn page, with tracking parameters removed.
